exposure: SARS-CoV-2 infection status (positive vs. negative) in asymptomatic pregnant women at delivery
outcome: prelabor rupture of membranes at term
cohort: Asymptomatic pregnant women admitted for delivery in 42 hospitals in Spain between March and May 2020, tested for SARS-CoV-2.
finding: Asymptomatic SARS-CoV-2 positive mothers had a higher odds of prelabor rupture of membranes at term but no increase in other key maternal or neonatal outcomes compared to negative mothers.
